name: MolTrust Trust Registry
description: Production trust infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. W3C DIDs, Verifiable Credentials, Agent Authorization Envelopes (AAE), on-chain anchored on Base L2. Reference implementation of the Trust Registry Binding for A2A v1.0.

extensions.description: W3C DID-based agent trust scoring with on-chain behavioral history
Agent Authorization Envelope - Storage-only declarative permission model with MANDATE/CONSTRAINTS/VALIDITY blocks; runtime enforcement is roadmap (Q3 2026).
x402 micropayment protocol on Base L2 for paid skill endpoints
Inventory of additional discovery files beyond agent-card
Proprietary MolTrust event protocol (pending/acknowledge polling). Name-inspired by OpenID-CAEP but NOT SET/RFC 8417 compliant — not a Shared Signals stream/transmitter/receiver implementation.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Free API key from POST /auth/signup (email only, no card): Free tier is 100 requests/day, and POST /identity/register grants 100 credits. Paid tiers (Professional/Scale/Enterprise) raise usage limits but are not required to register.

moltrust-did.name: X-MolTrust-DID
moltrust-did.description: Agent DID for self-identification on trust-gated endpoints

aae-envelope.description: Agent Authorization Envelope as JWS-signed bearer token. MANDATE/CONSTRAINTS/VALIDITY blocks. Declared schema; HTTP-auth-layer implementation in progress.

skills.name: Agent Trust Score
skills.description: Returns W3C DID-based trust score (0-100) with behavioral history breakdown, sybil penalty, anomaly flags, on-chain proof. Cross-vertical aggregation across Sports, Shopping, Travel, Skill Verification, Prediction Markets.
examples: What is the trust score of did:moltrust:abc123?
Verify this agent's behavioral history
Check if this agent meets minimum trust requirements

skills.name: DID Resolution
skills.description: Resolves W3C Decentralized Identifiers (did:moltrust) to DID Documents with verification methods and service endpoints. DIF Universal Resolver compatible (driver published at uresolver.moltrust.ch).
examples: Resolve did:moltrust:abc123
Get the public key for this agent DID

skills.name: Verifiable Credential Verification
skills.description: Verifies W3C Verifiable Credentials including Agent Authorization Envelopes (AAE) with delegation chain validation. Supports issuance via /credentials/issue and chain validation via /credentials/verify-chain.
examples: Verify this agent's authorization credential
Check if this AAE delegation chain is valid
Validate agent permissions for payment:write

skills.name: Wallet Binding Verification
skills.description: Verifies cryptographic binding between agent DID and blockchain wallet address (EVM Base + Solana). Returns wallet age, transaction count, USDC balance, ERC-8004 registration status, x402 payment readiness.
examples: Is this agent payment-ready on Base L2?
Verify wallet binding for did:moltrust:abc123

skills.name: Sybil & Anomaly Detection
skills.description: Two-layer sybil detection: (1) embedded in trust-score response (flags array + sybil_penalty in breakdown), (2) dedicated paid endpoint via MoltGuard with on-chain wallet age, counterparty graph, funding-source clustering. Paid via x402 ($0.10 USDC).
examples: Scan this agent cluster for sybil patterns
Check behavioral anomaly flags for this DID
Is this wallet funded by a known sybil source?

skills.name: EU AI Act risk classification
skills.description: Classify an AI system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: risk tier (prohibited/high/limited/minimal), obligations checklist, gap analysis, with EUR-Lex article pins.
examples: Is a CV-screening agent high-risk under the EU AI Act?
Assess this use case against Annex III

skills.name: EU declaration of conformity (Annex V)
skills.description: Issue an Annex V EU declaration of conformity as a signed W3C Verifiable Credential (MolTrustConformityDeclaration).
examples: Issue a declaration of conformity for my AI system
Create an Annex V VC

skills.name: Compliance report
skills.description: HTML/JSON report: identity, latest risk assessment, obligations, gaps, declarations on record, audit summary.
examples: Show the compliance report for did:moltrust:abc123

skills.name: Article 73 serious-incident recording
skills.description: Record an Article 73 serious incident and compute its staggered reporting deadline (2/10/15 days) with deadline status.
examples: Record a serious incident and tell me the reporting deadline

skills.name: UCAN delegation minting
skills.description: Mint a UCAN 0.10.0 delegation token with scoped capabilities, attenuation and a proof chain.
examples: Delegate scoped authority to another agent

skills.name: UCAN delegation verification
skills.description: Verify a UCAN token and its proof chain: signature, time bounds, iss/aud alignment, attenuation monotonicity, revocation.
examples: Verify this UCAN delegation token

skills.name: Batch reputation
skills.description: Reputation scores and ratings for up to 500 agent DIDs in a single call.
examples: Get reputation for these 300 agents

skills.name: Merkle batch anchoring
skills.description: Merkle-batch a set of evidence hashes into a single root with per-leaf proof paths.
examples: Anchor these evidence hashes into one Merkle root
